title: Active metadata save stores an object without its package namespace prefix that publish-drafts then refuses (NAMESPACE_PREFIX)
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect — reproduced through a public HTTP door, landing file named (the two runtime save doors disagree on one rule).
Path: automation.rollup-summary-filter (checklist item priority P1; found while driving its step 7, outside its clauses — no clause failed)
QA-source: #24545 · automation.rollup-summary-filter · step 7 (incidental, outside clauses)
Type: Bug — violates ADR-0129 D2 ("every object it defines MUST be named namespace_shortName").
Reader: the `packages/metadata-protocol` owner picked at triage — first step is the direct/active `saveMetaItem` path in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`; if the fix is instead an ADR exemption for the direct-save door, it is a maintainer ruling (precedent class: #23388).
Duplicate check (open AND closed): "metadata PUT save object unprefixed name namespace prefix not enforced direct save active" → 16 hits (package-binding / D9.9 ownership families, none match) · "NAMESPACE_PREFIX publish-drafts refused but saveMetaItem accepts" → 40 hits (none match) · "namespace prefix enforcement studio publish only, active object save bypasses prefix rule ADR-0129" → 29 hits (none exact; #23388 is the same class for a different rule).
reach: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/v1_report?package=com.v1.rollup` (package namespace `rollup`) → 200 `state:active`, the object is live; a draft edit of the same object → `POST /api/v1/packages/com.v1.rollup/publish-drafts` → outcome `refused`, code `NAMESPACE_PREFIX`. Measured on stock showcase at 5b14b7f3.

## What happens

For a package with a declared namespace, the direct (active) object save door accepts an object name that lacks the `namespace_` prefix and makes it live. The draft-publish door for the same package refuses the very same name with NAMESPACE_PREFIX. So an object can be created that can never again be edited through drafts, and the two runtime doors give opposite verdicts on one name in one package. `os validate` (exit 1) and `os build` (exit 2) both refuse the shape — the gap is runtime-only.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, framework 5b14b7f3)

1. Boot showcase, sign in `admin@objectos.ai` / `admin123`.
2. `POST /api/v1/packages` body `{"id":"com.v1.rollup","name":"V1 Rollup","version":"0.1.0","type":"app"}` → 201, `manifest.namespace` = `rollup`.
3. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/v1_report?package=com.v1.rollup` body `{"name":"v1_report","label":"V1 Report","sharingModel":"private","fields":{"title":{"type":"text","label":"Title"}}}`
   - Expected (ADR-0129 D2): refusal NAMESPACE_PREFIX, "Rename it to rollup_v1_report".
   - Actual: 200 `state:"active"`; `GET /api/v1/meta/object/v1_report` serves it and `POST /api/v1/data/v1_report {"title":"x"}` creates a record.
4. Same PUT with `&mode=draft` and a changed label → 200 `state:"draft"`.
5. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.v1.rollup/publish-drafts` body `{}` → 200 with `outcome:"refused"`, `failed[0].code:"NAMESPACE_PREFIX"`: "Object 'v1_report' is missing the package namespace prefix. Rename it to 'rollup_v1_report' (namespace = 'rollup')."

## Contract

- `docs/adr/0129-object-name-is-the-canonical-id.md:45-55` (D2): every object a package defines MUST be `namespace_shortName`; enforcement named at compile time (`validateNamespacePrefix()`) and at Studio publish.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts:3-14` states the same MUST.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:26329-26340` (`publishPackageDrafts`) refuses the unprefixed draft; `protocol.ts:27873-27874` itself notes "a direct-publish save, which no prefix gate reads".
- The direct-save door already runs other author-time gates on the same body (it refused a missing `sharingModel` with 422 INVALID_METADATA), so the prefix rule is the one that is skipped.

## Mechanism and fix landing

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` — the active/direct `saveMetaItem` path for type `object` under a package with `manifest.namespace` does not call the prefix validator that `publishPackageDrafts` uses (~26366).
- Fix (one of): apply the same `validateObjectNamespacePrefix` check on the active save (refuse with NAMESPACE_PREFIX), or record a ruling exempting the direct-save door and amend the ADR-0129 D2 chokepoint list. Either way the two doors should agree.
- Severity hint: medium — reachable by any metadata author with save rights; leaves a live object that drafts can no longer publish.
